description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Maximum Retail Prices on rice with effect from 10 th April 2020
categorisation: This gazette content contains a regulatory order issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. It establishes maximum retail prices for specific rice varieties, which constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure, land, commercial, elections, public service, judicial, or miscellaneous matters.
